# Sorrel

> Sorrel is an evidence-first data-analysis service. It accepts tabular datasets, executes a governed seven-stage workflow, and returns checked findings, charts, reports, limitations, and an audit trail.

Use the API or MCP endpoint for actions. Public documentation never grants access to uploaded datasets. Analysis runs are asynchronous and return a run identifier.

## Start Here

- [Product overview](http://localhost:8501/docs/overview.md): What Sorrel does and does not do.
- [Analysis workflow](http://localhost:8501/docs/workflow.md): The seven stages and their outputs.
- [Safety and privacy](http://localhost:8501/docs/safety.md): Data handling, sandboxing, PII, and retention.

## Integrate

- [API quickstart](http://localhost:8501/docs/api-quickstart.md): Upload, start, poll, and fetch a result.
- [MCP setup](http://localhost:8501/docs/mcp.md): Remote MCP endpoint, tools, and authentication.
